relations.quote: It is built inside a [Finite linear network with roles and frames](linear-network-roles.md).

symbols.name: ground set size
symbols.meaning: The number of elements of the ground set $[h]$, here 100.
symbols.quote: Let $[h]=\{1,\dots,h\}$ be the ground set, with $h=100$, and let $\mathcal T$ be its set of three-element subsets.

symbols.name: triple set
symbols.meaning: The set of three-element subsets of the ground set $[h]$.
symbols.quote: Let $[h]=\{1,\dots,h\}$ be the ground set, with $h=100$, and let $\mathcal T$ be its set of three-element subsets.

symbols.name: indicator vector
symbols.meaning: The indicator vector of the triple $T$, with entry 1 at each element of $T$ and 0 elsewhere.
symbols.quote: For $T\in\mathcal T$, let $t_T$ be its indicator vector.

symbols.name: triple value
symbols.meaning: The value carried by the triple $T$ as a source of the network.

symbols.name: data index
symbols.meaning: An ordered triple $(T_1,T_2,T_3)$ of triples, indexing one data entry of the network.
symbols.quote: Each index $\alpha=(T_1,T_2,T_3)$ gets the line $U_\alpha$ spanned by $t_{T_1}\otimes t_{T_2}\otimes t_{T_3}$.

symbols.name: index label
symbols.meaning: The line in the label space spanned by the tensor product of the indicator vectors of the triples in $\alpha$.
symbols.quote: Each index $\alpha=(T_1,T_2,T_3)$ gets the line $U_\alpha$ spanned by $t_{T_1}\otimes t_{T_2}\otimes t_{T_3}$.

symbols.name: label space
symbols.meaning: The ambient space $(\mathbb Q^h)^{\otimes 3}$ in which all labels are subspaces.
symbols.quote: Let $\mathcal F=(\mathbb Q^h)^{\otimes 3}$, of dimension $m=h^3$ (the letter $m$ changes meaning here).

symbols.name: label dimension
symbols.meaning: The dimension of the label space $\mathcal F$, which is $h^3$.
symbols.quote: Let $\mathcal F=(\mathbb Q^h)^{\otimes 3}$, of dimension $m=h^3$ (the letter $m$ changes meaning here).

symbols.name: all-one matrix
symbols.meaning: The $h\times h$ matrix with every entry equal to 1.
symbols.quote: Over $\mathbb Q$, the bilinear form with matrix $I-J/9$ gives $\langle t_T,t_{T'}\rangle=|T\cap T'|-1$, zero exactly for neighbors, where $J$ is the all-one matrix.

symbols.name: label projection
symbols.meaning: The projection onto the subspace $U$ along its orthogonal complement $U^\perp$, assigned to a gate or sink with label $U$.
symbols.quote: Give each gate or sink with label $U$ the projection $P_U$ onto $U$ along $U^\perp$, each source of index $\alpha$ the matrix $-P_{U_\alpha}$, and other sources zero.

symbols.name: smaller call count
symbols.meaning: The number of smaller calls, the sum over all edges of the rank of the difference of the matrices at its two ends.
symbols.quote: Let $s$, the number of smaller calls, be the sum of the ranks of the edge differences over all edges.

symbols.name: data index count
symbols.meaning: The number of data indices $\alpha$, which is also the total dimension of the source labels.
symbols.quote: Signed changes telescope to $Wm-2N$, where $N$ counts the indices $\alpha$.

symbols.name: lost label dimension
symbols.meaning: The total dimension lost by the label along the decreasing edges of the network.
symbols.quote: Decreasing edges lose a total $L$, adding $2L$; the $N$ source edges add $N$.
